mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 73 degrees and a Waxing Crescent moon above.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various roles. You must commit to two shifts a month and be able to handle physical tasks like lifting and climbing stairs. Please remember to respect participant privacy and confidentiality at all times.

Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to the Verona Ice Arena for Girls Try Hockey. Tomorrow, check out the UGM event at Epic Systems or stop by Insight Wellness for a yoga session.
On Wednesday, August 6, police arrested a 49-year-old driver for his fourth O W I following a traffic stop for erratic driving.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so make sure to stop by once they are ready to serve.
